name: Razer Wolverine V3 Pro (Wired)
notes: 103-byte descriptor. Source: openrazer issue #2364. Vendor-specific 63-byte I/O reports (ID 2) for controller data + Consumer Controls (ID 1) for media keys.

layout.note: Razer Wolverine V3 Pro profile in HM catalog declares 0 axes / 0 buttons (placeholder shape). Real device per razer.com: 2 Hall-effect sticks + 2 Hall-effect analog triggers + 6 remappable extras (M1-M6). Authoring deferred until descriptor surfaces full input shape.
